description: Land Acquisition - Kekulandala, Agalawattha D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration by the Minister that specific land parcels (totaling 6.0702 Hectares) are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The content describes the exact location, boundaries, and extent of the land, making it clearly land-related matter falling under Type 4 (Land Gazettes). While it mentions a government minister, the core content is about land acquisition rather than government structure or personnel changes.
